title: Fourier expansion of a low-degree function
statement: Let $n,d$ be nonnegative integers and let $p:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ have Fourier degree at most $d$. For every $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, $p(x)$ equals the sum over all subsets $S\subseteq[n]$ with $|S|\le d$ of the Fourier coefficient of $p$ at $S$ multiplied by the monomial indexed by $S$ evaluated at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: The Fourier degree of $p$ is at most $d$
